purpose: Single ownership contract for Git engineering files and Perforce creative content.

git.description: Mergeable engineering, project configuration, automation, and documentation.

perforce.description: Active Unreal content, world-partition packages, exports, and irreplaceable source art.

forbidden_dual_ownership: A path may match exactly one authority; Git and Perforce roots must never overlap.
Level maps and their External Actors/External Objects are Perforce-owned as one bundle.
No Content/, Exports/, or RawArt/ path may be added to a Git batch.

archive.archive_unit: compressed milestone bundle with manifest and SHA-256 checksums

cutover_states.planned: Perforce topology and ownership are designed, but the Unreal production client has not been proven against the depot.
cutover_states.active_pilot: Unreal Engine is connected to Perforce and source-control operations are working; migration may still have Git/LFS overlap and incomplete cross-workspace proof.
cutover_states.production: Perforce is the normal production authority for declared creative roots, including proven World Partition and second-workspace round trips.
cutover_states.cutover_complete: Declared Perforce roots have no remaining Git ownership and all cutover gates pass.

ue_source_control_operations.note: Source-control operations are working in the Unreal Editor.
